page.notes: Running head and page number read from the scan; the header is partly faint, so the running head is marked as the likely reading. Several left-margin notes are fragmentary and cut at the page edge; they are transcribed as far as legible, with [?] where uncertain. The first word of the page is partly hidden and the letter before "tris" is unclear. The word "impe-ptibus" at a line end is uncertain. "tam-" at the line end and "vacatem" are doubtful. Superscript reference marks (*, b, c, d, e) are copied as seen; the footnote for {b} is a guess and should be checked. The catchword "conciliis" stands alone below the last line.
